history.notRedacted: Exports are not redacted: they include headers, bodies and any secrets in them.

analyticsNotice.message: Requestr counts anonymous usage to improve the app, never your requests or data.

backupNudge.title: Back up your workspace
backupNudge.description: Your requests are saved only in this browser. Export a backup so you never lose them.

feedback.title: Send feedback
feedback.textPlaceholder: Bugs, ideas, anything on your mind…
feedback.textPlaceholderLow: A bug, a confusing step, something missing…
feedback.textPlaceholderHigh: A feature or workflow you rely on…
feedback.disclosure: We only receive what you write here.
feedback.unconfigured: Feedback isn't available in this build.

urlBar.title: Build and send a request
urlBar.body: Type a URL, pick a method, then press Send or Ctrl/Cmd+Enter.

requestTabs.title: Shape the request
requestTabs.body: Add query params, headers, a body and auth from these tabs.

response.title: Read the response
response.body: Status, timing, size and the body land here as soon as you send.

sampleRequests.title: Start from a sample
sampleRequests.body: Open a ready-made request to see how responses look.

collections.title: Organize with collections
collections.body: Group related requests into folders so every API is easy to find.

save.title: Save to a collection
save.body: Keep requests you reuse in a collection so they are one click away.

environments.title: Switch environments
environments.body: Use variables like baseUrl and swap values between environments.

chains.title: Chain requests together
chains.body: Build visual flows where one response feeds the next request.

relay.title: Ask Relay AI
relay.body: Describe what you want and Relay drafts the request for you.

palette.title: Move faster with shortcuts
palette.body: Press Ctrl/Cmd+K for the command palette, or Ctrl/Cmd+/ to see every shortcut.
